integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained apart from standard multiplicativity of Euler's totient. The bundled finite computation is corroborative and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a necessary prime-support condition only; it does not decide existence in the open range \(k\ge4\), and older 1939/1982 foundational articles were not directly available for full-text comparison.
title: A prime-support sieve for perfect totients of the form \(3^k p\)
